author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a horizontal arm bar through the figure and a slanted leg merging into cramped short steps (read as a glyph); redrawn like the reference: an upright walking figure (head 8 above a short neck, one arm forward and up, the other back, back leg planted, front leg lifted onto the first step) and a staircase of even 8x8 steps rising to the upper right.
omissions: Figure drawn as a stick figure rather than the reference's outlined limbs.
